# Show eight chart and grid openings in both gallery themes

## Context

A visitor who switches the gallery to light still sees a single cover for these eight examples. Their ordinary opening frames now show the subject in both themes. Sparklines shows all six metrics and its live controls. Mermaid shows the source beside its rendered diagram. Server-side paging shows the request, the returned rows and the pager together.

## The Problem

Eight old camera recipes still select fixed crops, sizes or later states for these examples. The earlier capture of Sparklines turned off its feed, pulse and smoothing, then cropped away two metrics. The landing shows what a visitor can actually see and do.

## The Architectural Reality

The shared camera in `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs` produces a 960 × 540 CSS-pixel published opening in each palette when the recipe is absent. Image files live in `neomjs/pages`. The two family catalogs declare availability through their existing `hasLightCover` field. Design authority is the ordinary-opening rule on #21140, paired producer #21933 and the v14 steward’s approval of one finite batch under #21942.

## The Fix

Retire the eight obsolete entries from `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.json`. Publish one Pages batch and mark those same records in the two family files once their assets are available.

| Family | Records |
| --- | --- |
| Charts, Canvas & Maps | `am-charts`, `mermaid`, `sparklines` |
| Grid & Table | `grid-cell-types`, `grid-countries`, `grid-header-groups`, `grid-server-side`, `table-filtering` |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The actual stock camera produces both 1280 × 720 images for all eight, each in its requested palette with zero interaction steps. The manifest contains eight fewer recipes.
- [ ] Both public asset URLs for each record return the reviewed bytes before the Engine flags are merged. Inspect the openings at gallery width and compare both full group pages.
- [ ] The Portal theme switch selects and decodes each record’s dark and light files. Verify at least one visible card and one initially offscreen card by ordinary navigation.

## Out of Scope

The CSV preview, active cell editor, pinned-column scroll and streaming-in-progress cover need an opening that tells their story. Those stay with #21942. The first ten-cover wave #22041 is complete. #22049 owns the gallery’s lead-card geometry.

## Related

The v14 steward narrowed the original nine-record proposal to eight after two ordinary camera runs failed on the animated leaderboard. Dark never held still for the one-second window on the first attempt. On a separate run, light failed the same 15-second observation. Its original recipe is retained and the [measured disposition stays on #21942](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21942#issuecomment-7088921518). A general way to capture active examples remains a producer design question.

Parent #21942. Latest 20 open and all-state chart/cover and recipe searches on 23 Nov 01:06 UTC, 47 open. Checked prior #21977 and #21826, current assignments and recent all-state peer claims. #21934 closed its previous publication, and the steward confirmed no surviving activation leaf covered the original nine. Owned pre-cut work. The wider backfill remains open.
